outline: 隨著台灣農工型態的轉變以及越來越高的生活品質要求,地下水所扮演的角將日益重要,地下水的領域涵蓋水量,水質及防災三方面,修習此一學科,可以了解地下水水文及水力學之基本原理,進而掌握地下水水理與污染傳輸之特性,以作為規劃與管理地下水資源之依據.
schedule:
1.Introduction
2.Hydrologic Processes
3.Basic Principles of Ground-Water Flow
4~5.Basic Principles of Ground-Water Flow
Theory of Ground-Water Flow
6.Theory of Ground-Water Flow in Unsaturated Zone
7.Response of Confined Aquifers to Pumping
8.Response of Confined Aquifers to Pumping
9.期中考 (40%)
10~11.Response of an Unconfined Aquifer to Pumping
12.Slug, Step, and Intermittent Tests
13.Superposition theory
14~15.Basics of Transport, Advection, and Dispersion
16~17.Ground water sampling and contamination control
18.期末考 (40%)
assessment:
期中考 (40%)
期末考 (40%)
平時成績(20%)
